description: This file defines the `AOR_Field` class, a data model extending `Basic`, representing a custom field entity within the SuiteCRM module `AOR_Fields`. It includes properties corresponding to database fields, a constructor, and a method `save_lines` for saving multiple field records, which interacts with other components like `AOW_WorkFlow` utilities, `LoggerManager`, and `BeanFactory`.

classes.name: AOR_Field
classes.description: A class representing a custom field in the SuiteCRM module, with properties mapping to database columns and a method for saving related line items.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Saves multiple line records related to the `AOR_Field`, handling creation, update, and deletion based on posted data. It manages complex data encoding, validation, and interactions with other module components.
